children: Finland’s current account swung to a EUR 242 million deficit in July 2026 from a EUR 1,960 million surplus in the corresponding month of the previous year.
The deterioration was largely driven by a sharp decline in the goods account surplus, which narrowed to EUR 232 million from EUR 2,117 million a year earlier.
At the same time, the services deficit widened to EUR 718 million from EUR 590 million, while the primary income surplus decreased to EUR 439 million from EUR 581 million.
Meanwhile, the secondary income shortfall increased to EUR 195 million from EUR 148 million.

title: Finland Current Account Swings to Deficit in July
